annotations.text:
Two directions for the same search-first landing page.

Same copy, same anatomy — name, tagline, address field, one primary action. What differs is form: A leans on the map, B leans on the type.

The honest case for each (and what each costs you) is on the Foundations board. Pick one and the next step is building it in React.

One thing to decide with the direction:

These use webfonts — Spectral + Public Sans for A, Archivo + Newsreader for B — because system-ui alone can't carry either look, and Public Sans is the face US government sites use.

That means one <link> to Google Fonts in index.html. If you'd rather stay fully self-hosted, say so and I'll rework the type on whichever direction you pick.
